8298// Bytecode / IR / Token / AST helpers
8299// ============================================================
8300
8301/// 在字节码列表中高亮当前执行到的指令行。
8302void Ide::highlightBytecodeLine(const std::string& chunkName, size_t ip) {
8303 const CompileResult& compileResult = controller_->lastCompileResult();
8304 const BytecodeChunk* targetChunk = nullptr;
8305
8306 if (chunkName == "main" || chunkName.empty()) {
8307 targetChunk = &compileResult.mainChunk;
8308 } else {
8309 auto it = compileResult.functionChunks.find(chunkName);
8310 if (it != compileResult.functionChunks.end())
8311 targetChunk = &it->second;
8312 }
8313 if (!targetChunk || targetChunk->code.empty())
8314 return;
8315
8316 int instrIndex = 0;
8317 if (ip < targetChunk->ipToInstrIndex.size() && targetChunk->ipToInstrIndex[ip] >= 0) {
8318 instrIndex = targetChunk->ipToInstrIndex[ip];
8319 } else {
8320 size_t offset = 0;
8321 while (offset < targetChunk->code.size()) {
8322 if (offset == ip)
8323 break;
8324 offset += targetChunk->instructionSizeAt(offset);
8325 instrIndex++;
8326 }
8327 }
8328
8329 int startRow = 0;
8330 for (const auto& info : chunkRowMap_) {
8331 if (info.name == chunkName) {
8332 startRow = info.startRow;
8333 break;
8334 }
8335 }
8336
8337 int targetRow = startRow + instrIndex;
8338 if (targetRow >= 0 && targetRow < bytecodeList_->count()) {
8339 bytecodeList_->setCurrentRow(targetRow);
8340 bytecodeList_->scrollToItem(bytecodeList_->item(targetRow));
8341 }
8342}
8343
8344/// 字节码行点击：定位/选中对应源码行。
8345void Ide::onBytecodeRowClicked(int row) {
8346 if (row < 0 || !codeEditor_ || !controller_)
8347 return;
8348 // Find which chunk this row belongs to and get the source line
8349 const auto& compileResult = controller_->lastCompileResult();
8350 for (const auto& info : chunkRowMap_) {
8351 if (row >= info.startRow && row < info.startRow + info.rowCount) {
8352 int instrIndex = row - info.startRow;
8353 const BytecodeChunk* chunk = nullptr;
8354 if (info.name == "main") {
8355 chunk = &compileResult.mainChunk;
8356 } else {
8357 auto it = compileResult.functionChunks.find(info.name);
8358 if (it != compileResult.functionChunks.end())
8359 chunk = &it->second;
8360 }
8361 if (!chunk)
8362 return;
8363 // Walk instructions to find the byte offset for this instruction index
8364 size_t byteOffset = 0;
8365 for (int i = 0; i < instrIndex; ++i) {
8366 byteOffset += chunk->instructionSizeAt(byteOffset);
8367 }
8368 int sourceLine = chunk->getLine(byteOffset);
8369 if (sourceLine > 0) {
8370 codeEditor_->highlightSourceLine(sourceLine);
8371 }
8372 return;
8373 }
8374 }
8375}
8376
8377/// 用编译结果填充字节码列表（带语法高亮 HTML）。
8378void Ide::populateBytecodeList() {
8379 const CompileResult& compileResult = controller_->lastCompileResult();
8380 QString currentSource = codeEditor_ ? codeEditor_->toPlainText() : QString();
8381 // BUG-ORCH-2 fix: 缓存哈希需区分引擎模式，否则引擎切换后显示陈旧字节码
8382 int engineMode = engineCombo_ ? engineCombo_->currentIndex() : 0;
8383 size_t currentHash = qHash(currentSource) ^ (static_cast<size_t>(engineMode) << 32);
8384 if (currentHash == lastBytecodeSourceHash_ && bytecodeList_->count() > 0)
8385 return;
8386 lastBytecodeSourceHash_ = currentHash;
8387
8388 bytecodeList_->clear();
8389 chunkRowMap_.clear();
8390
8391 if (compileResult.mainChunk.code.empty()) {
8392 bytecodeList_->addItem(mlTr("(无字节码)"));
8393 return;
8394 }
8395
8396 // Wrap setUpdatesEnabled in try/catch (project constraint)
8397 bytecodeList_->setUpdatesEnabled(false);
8398 try {
8399 int currentRow = 0;
8400 const QFont& bytecodeFont = GuiTextUtils::monospaceFont(10);
8401
8402 {
8403 int startRow = currentRow;
8404 size_t offset = 0;
8405 while (offset < compileResult.mainChunk.code.size()) {
8406 std::string instr = compileResult.mainChunk.disassembleInstruction(offset);
8407 auto* item = new QListWidgetItem;
8408 item->setText(QString::fromStdString(instr));
8409 item->setFont(bytecodeFont);
8410 // 第八轮：设置 HTML 数据供 RichTextItemDelegate 渲染
8411 item->setData(RichTextItemDelegate::kHtmlRole, formatBytecodeHtml(instr));
8412 bytecodeList_->addItem(item);
8413 currentRow++;
8414 offset += compileResult.mainChunk.instructionSizeAt(offset);
8415 }
8416 chunkRowMap_.push_back({"main", startRow, currentRow - startRow});
8417 }
8418
8419 for (const auto& kv : compileResult.functionChunks) {
8420 std::string headerText = "---- " + kv.first + " (arity=" + std::to_string(kv.second.arity) + ") ----";
8421 auto* header = new QListWidgetItem;
8422 header->setText(QString::fromStdString(headerText));
8423 header->setFont(bytecodeFont);
8424 header->setData(RichTextItemDelegate::kHtmlRole, formatBytecodeHtml(headerText));
8425 bytecodeList_->addItem(header);
8426 currentRow++;
8427
8428 int startRow = currentRow;
8429 size_t funcOffset = 0;
8430 while (funcOffset < kv.second.code.size()) {
8431 std::string instr = kv.second.disassembleInstruction(funcOffset);
8432 auto* item = new QListWidgetItem;
8433 item->setText(QString::fromStdString(instr));
8434 item->setFont(bytecodeFont);
8435 item->setData(RichTextItemDelegate::kHtmlRole, formatBytecodeHtml(instr));
8436 bytecodeList_->addItem(item);
8437 currentRow++;
8438 funcOffset += kv.second.instructionSizeAt(funcOffset);
8439 }
8440 chunkRowMap_.push_back({kv.first, startRow, currentRow - startRow});
8441 }
8442 } catch (...) {
8443 // Ensure updates are re-enabled even on exception
8444 }
8445 bytecodeList_->setUpdatesEnabled(true);
8446}

8462/// 刷新 Token 表格（词法分析产物可视化）。
8463void Ide::updateTokenTable() {
8464 const std::vector<Token>& tokens = controller_->lastTokens();
8465 static constexpr int MAX_DISPLAY = 10000;
8466 int displayCount = static_cast<int>(std::min(tokens.size(), static_cast<size_t>(MAX_DISPLAY)));
8467 tokenTable_->setRowCount(displayCount);
8468 tokenTable_->setUpdatesEnabled(false);
8469 try {
8470 for (int i = 0; i < displayCount; ++i) {
8471 const Token& tok = tokens[i];
8472 // 第八轮：列顺序 行号、列号、类型、词素、字面量
8473 tokenTable_->setItem(i, 0, new QTableWidgetItem(QString::number(tok.line)));
8474 tokenTable_->setItem(i, 1, new QTableWidgetItem(QString::number(tok.column)));
8475 tokenTable_->setItem(i, 2, new QTableWidgetItem(QString::fromStdString(Token::typeToString(tok.type))));
8476 tokenTable_->setItem(i, 3, new QTableWidgetItem(QString::fromStdString(tok.lexeme)));
8477 tokenTable_->setItem(i, 4, new QTableWidgetItem(QString::fromStdString(tok.literalToString())));
8478 // Token type color coding
8479 QColor typeColor;
8480 switch (tok.type) {
8481 // Keywords: blue
8482 case TokenType::TK_VAR:
8483 case TokenType::TK_FUN:
8484 case TokenType::TK_IF:
8485 case TokenType::TK_ELSE:
8486 case TokenType::TK_WHILE:
8487 case TokenType::TK_FOR:
8488 case TokenType::TK_RETURN:
8489 case TokenType::TK_IMPORT:
8490 case TokenType::TK_FROM:
8491 case TokenType::TK_EXPORT:
8492 case TokenType::TK_CLASS:
8493 case TokenType::TK_EXTENDS:
8494 case TokenType::TK_SUPER:
8495 case TokenType::TK_PRINT:
8496 case TokenType::TK_BREAK:
8497 case TokenType::TK_CONTINUE:
8498 case TokenType::TK_TRY:
8499 case TokenType::TK_CATCH:
8500 case TokenType::TK_THROW:
8501 case TokenType::TK_AND:
8502 case TokenType::TK_OR:
8503 case TokenType::TK_NOT:
8504 case TokenType::TK_TRUE:
8505 case TokenType::TK_FALSE:
8506 case TokenType::TK_NULL:
8507 case TokenType::TK_DICT:
8508 case TokenType::TK_ARRAY:
8509 case TokenType::TK_INT:
8510 case TokenType::TK_FLOAT:
8511 case TokenType::TK_BOOL:
8512 case TokenType::TK_STRING_TYPE:
8513 typeColor = QColor("#268BD2");
8514 break;
8515 // Number literals: green
8516 case TokenType::TK_INT_LIT:
8517 case TokenType::TK_FLOAT_LIT:
8518 typeColor = QColor("#B58900");
8519 break;
8520 // String literals: red
8521 case TokenType::TK_STRING_LIT:
8522 case TokenType::TK_STRING_PART:
8523 case TokenType::TK_INTERP_START:
8524 case TokenType::TK_INTERP_END:
8525 typeColor = QColor("#2AA198");
8526 break;
8527 // Comments: neutral gray italic
8528 case TokenType::TK_LINE_COMMENT:
8529 case TokenType::TK_BLOCK_COMMENT:
8530 typeColor = QColor("#5A5A5A");
8531 break;
8532 // Operators: red
8533 case TokenType::TK_PLUS:
8534 case TokenType::TK_MINUS:
8535 case TokenType::TK_STAR:
8536 case TokenType::TK_SLASH:
8537 case TokenType::TK_PERCENT:
8538 case TokenType::TK_EQ:
8539 case TokenType::TK_NEQ:
8540 case TokenType::TK_LT:
8541 case TokenType::TK_GT:
8542 case TokenType::TK_LEQ:
8543 case TokenType::TK_GEQ:
8544 case TokenType::TK_ASSIGN:
8545 typeColor = QColor("#CB4B16");
8546 break;
8547 // Error: bright red
8548 case TokenType::TK_ERROR:
8549 typeColor = QColor("#DC322F");
8550 break;
8551 // Identifier / default: normal dark gray
8552 default:
8553 typeColor = QColor("#1E1E1E");
8554 break;
8555 }
8556
8557 for (int col = 0; col < 5; ++col) {
8558 tokenTable_->item(i, col)->setTextAlignment(Qt::AlignLeft | Qt::AlignVCenter);
8559 if (col == 2) {
8560 // Type column: use token type color
8561 tokenTable_->item(i, col)->setForeground(typeColor);
8562 if (tok.type == TokenType::TK_LINE_COMMENT || tok.type == TokenType::TK_BLOCK_COMMENT) {
8563 QFont f = tokenTable_->item(i, col)->font();
8564 f.setItalic(true);
8565 tokenTable_->item(i, col)->setFont(f);
8566 }
8567 } else if (col < 2) {
8568 // Line/column: gray
8569 tokenTable_->item(i, col)->setForeground(QColor("#6e6e6e"));
8570 }
8571 }
8572 }
8573 } catch (...) {
8574 // Ensure updates are re-enabled even on exception
8575 }
8576 tokenTable_->setUpdatesEnabled(true);
8577 tokenTable_->resizeColumnsToContents();
8578 if (tokens.size() > static_cast<size_t>(MAX_DISPLAY)) {
8579 appendOutput(mlTr("[提示] Token 数量 %1 超过显示上限 %2，仅显示前 %2 条").arg(tokens.size()).arg(MAX_DISPLAY));
8580 }
8581}

8592/// 刷新调试信息面板（变量快照/调用栈）。
8593void Ide::updateDebugInfo() {
8594 auto vars = controller_->getDebugVariableSnapshot();
8595 debugPanel_->updateVariables(vars);
8596 std::vector<CallStackEntry> stack;
8597 // BUG-DBG-6 fix: VM 模式下使用 VM 调用栈（VmStepper::getCallStack → IdeController::getVmCallStack），
8598 // 原 updateDebugInfo 始终使用 Interpreter 调用栈，VM 模式下显示空栈。
8599 // BUG-ORCH-6 fix: 用 isVmInitialized()/isVmRunning() 判断 VM 模式，
8600 // 不依赖 vmStackPanel_->isVisible()（dock 隐藏时走 Interpreter 路径不可靠）
8601 if (controller_->isVmInitialized() || controller_->isVmRunning()) {
8602 stack = controller_->getVmCallStack();
8603 } else {
8604 stack = controller_->getDebugCallStack();
8605 }
8606 debugPanel_->updateCallStack(stack);
8607}
8608
8609/// 统一切换运行态：启用/禁用运行/调试/停止按钮与界面锁。
8610void Ide::setRunningState(bool running) {
8611 bool isDebug = controller_->isDebugRun() && running;
8612 runAction_->setEnabled(!running);
8613 debugAction_->setEnabled(!running);
8614 stepInAction_->setEnabled(isDebug);
8615 stepOverAction_->setEnabled(isDebug);
8616 stepOutAction_->setEnabled(isDebug);
8617 resumeAction_->setEnabled(isDebug);
8618 stopAction_->setEnabled(running);
8619 formatAction_->setEnabled(!running);
8620 compileAnalysisAction_->setEnabled(!running);
8621 // BUG-ORCH-4 fix: 运行/VM RUN 期间禁用引擎切换，避免中途切换导致状态不一致
8622 if (engineCombo_)
8623 engineCombo_->setEnabled(!running);
8624 if (codeEditor_)
8625 codeEditor_->setReadOnly(running);
8626 if (isDebug) {
8627 showDebugButtons(true);
8628 } else if (!running) {
8629 showDebugButtons(false);
8630 }
8631 if (running) {
8632 setVmStepActionsEnabled(false, false);
8633 } else if (!controller_->isVmRunning()) {
8634 bool vmInit = controller_->isVmInitialized();
8635 setVmStepActionsEnabled(vmInit, vmInit);
8636 showVmButtons(vmInit);
8637 }
8638 // 第八轮：状态栏运行状态提示
8639 if (statusRunLabel_) {
8640 if (running) {
8641 statusRunLabel_->setText(isDebug ? mlTr("调试中") : mlTr("运行中"));
8642 } else {
8643 statusRunLabel_->setText(QString());
8644 }
8645 }
8646}

8679

8698/// “保存”动作：将当前编辑器内容写回文件。
8699void Ide::onSave() {
8700 if (!codeEditor_)
8701 return;
8702 if (currentFilePath_.isEmpty()) {
8703 onSaveAs();
8704 return;
8705 }
8706 // 标识 IDE 自身保存触发 fileChanged，避免弹出"外部修改"对话框。
8707 // 500ms 后自动复位，防止 fileChanged 未触发时标志残留误吞后续外部修改。
8708 selfSaving_ = true;
8709 QTimer::singleShot(500, this, [this]() {
8710 if (!closing_)
8711 selfSaving_ = false;
8712 });
8713 QFile file(currentFilePath_);
8714 if (!file.open(QIODevice::WriteOnly | QIODevice::Text)) {
8715 InfoBar::warning(mlTr("错误"), mlTr("无法保存文件: ") + file.errorString(), Qt::Horizontal, true, 2500,
8716 InfoBar::Position::TOP_RIGHT, this);
8717 return;
8718 }
8719 QTextStream out(&file);
8720 out.setEncoding(QStringConverter::Utf8);
8721 out << codeEditor_->toPlainText();
8722 file.close();
8723 isDirty_ = false;
8724 codeEditor_->document()->setModified(false);
8725 int currIdx = editorTabWidget_->currentIndex();
8726 if (currIdx >= 0 && currIdx < static_cast<int>(editorTabs_.size())) {
8727 editorTabs_[currIdx].filePath = currentFilePath_;
8728 editorTabs_[currIdx].isUntitled = false;
8729 }
8730 updateWindowTitle();
8731 populateFileTree();
8732 // 保存后更新文件监视（处理 Save As 后路径变更、文件被替换后旧 watch 失效）
8733 setupFileWatcher(currentFilePath_);
8734}
8735
8736/// “另存为”动作：以新路径保存当前文件。
8737void Ide::onSaveAs() {
8738 QString startDir = workspaceDir_.isEmpty() ? QDir::homePath() : workspaceDir_;
8739 QString path =
8740 QFileDialog::getSaveFileName(this, mlTr("保存文件"), startDir, "MiniLang (*.mini *.ml);;All Files (*)");
8741 if (path.isEmpty())
8742 return;
8743 currentFilePath_ = path;
8744 // BUG-REPL-AUDIT-9 fix: 同步活动文件路径到 controller，供 REPL 模块加载器解析相对 import 路径
8745 controller_->setActiveFilePath(path.toStdString());
8746 int currIdx = editorTabWidget_->currentIndex();
8747 if (currIdx >= 0 && currIdx < static_cast<int>(editorTabs_.size())) {
8748 editorTabs_[currIdx].filePath = path;
8749 editorTabs_[currIdx].isUntitled = false;
8750 QFileInfo fi(path);
8751 editorTabWidget_->setTabText(currIdx, fi.fileName());
8752 }
8753 onSave();
8754 populateFileTree();
8755}

8757/// 保存前确认：存在修改时弹出保存对话框，返回是否可继续。
8758bool Ide::maybeSave() {
8759 if (!codeEditor_)
8760 return true;
8761 if (!codeEditor_->document()->isModified())
8762 return true;
8763 auto ret = QMessageBox::question(this, mlTr("MiniLang IDE"), mlTr("文件已修改，是否保存？"),
8764 QMessageBox::Save | QMessageBox::Discard | QMessageBox::Cancel, QMessageBox::Save);
8765 if (ret == QMessageBox::Save) {
8766 onSave();
8767 return !codeEditor_->document()->isModified();
8768 }
8769 if (ret == QMessageBox::Cancel)
8770 return false;
8771 return true;
8772}

8774/// 根据当前文件路径与脏标记刷新窗口标题。
8775void Ide::updateWindowTitle() {
8776 QString title = "MiniLang IDE";
8777 if (!workspaceDir_.isEmpty()) {
8778 QFileInfo fi(workspaceDir_);
8779 title += " - " + fi.fileName();
8780 }
8781 if (!currentFilePath_.isEmpty()) {
8782 QFileInfo fi(currentFilePath_);
8783 title += " / " + fi.fileName();
8784 }
8785 if (isDirty_)
8786 title += " *";
8787 setWindowTitle(title);
8788
8789 // 第九轮：更新自定义标题栏路径标签（灰色小字号）
8790 if (titlePathLabel_) {
8791 QString path;
8792 if (!currentFilePath_.isEmpty()) {
8793 path = currentFilePath_;
8794 if (isDirty_)
8795 path += " *";
8796 } else if (!workspaceDir_.isEmpty()) {
8797 path = workspaceDir_;
8798 }
8799 titlePathLabel_->setText(path);
8800 titlePathLabel_->setToolTip(path);
8801 }
8802}

8804/// 加载文件到编辑器（含编码检测与 BOM 去除）。
8805void Ide::loadFile(const QString& path) {
8806 int existingIdx = findTabForFile(path);
8807 if (existingIdx >= 0) {
8808 switchToTab(existingIdx);
8809 return;
8810 }
8811 int idx = createNewEditorTab();
8812 switchToTab(idx);
8813 loadFileIntoTab(idx, path);
8814}

8816// ============================================================
8817// 文件拖放支持（dragEnterEvent / dropEvent）
8818// ------------------------------------------------------------
8819// 主窗口接受从 Windows 资源管理器等拖入的 .mini/.ml 文件，
8820// 每个匹配文件调用 loadFile 加载到新标签。子控件（如欢迎页）
8821// 已自行 setAcceptDrops，事件优先派发给子控件，未接受时回退到主窗口。
8822// ============================================================
8823
8824/// 拖拽进入事件：仅接受含 .mini/.ml 文件的拖放。
8825void Ide::dragEnterEvent(QDragEnterEvent* event) {
8826 if (event->mimeData()->hasUrls()) {
8827 const auto urls = event->mimeData()->urls();
8828 for (const QUrl& url : urls) {
8829 const QString path = url.toLocalFile();
8830 if (path.endsWith(".mini", Qt::CaseInsensitive) || path.endsWith(".ml", Qt::CaseInsensitive)) {
8831 event->acceptProposedAction();
8832 return;
8833 }
8834 }
8835 }
8836 event->ignore();
8837}
8838
8839/// 拖拽放下事件：打开被拖入的源文件。
8840void Ide::dropEvent(QDropEvent* event) {
8841 if (!event->mimeData()->hasUrls()) {
8842 event->ignore();
8843 return;
8844 }
8845 const auto urls = event->mimeData()->urls();
8846 bool loaded = false;
8847 for (const QUrl& url : urls) {
8848 const QString path = url.toLocalFile();
8849 if (path.isEmpty())
8850 continue;
8851 if (path.endsWith(".mini", Qt::CaseInsensitive) || path.endsWith(".ml", Qt::CaseInsensitive)) {
8852 loadFile(path);
8853 loaded = true;
8854 }
8855 }
8856 if (loaded) {
8857 event->acceptProposedAction();
8858 } else {
8859 event->ignore();
8860 }
8861}

8863// ============================================================
8864// 文件外部修改监听（QFileSystemWatcher）
8865// ------------------------------------------------------------
8866// setupFileWatcher：切换/保存后更新被监视路径（一次只盯一个文件）
8867// onFileChangedExternally：外部编辑器修改/替换文件后弹框询问是否重载
8868// - selfSaving_ 标志：IDE 自身 onSave 触发的 fileChanged 直接跳过弹框
8869// - 文件被删除（Vim/某些编辑器先删再写）：100ms 后尝试重新 addPath
8870// - 文件被替换：旧 watch 失效，需重新 addPath
8871// ============================================================
8872
8873/// 为当前文件设置 QFileSystemWatcher 监视外部修改。
8874void Ide::setupFileWatcher(const QString& filePath) {
8875 if (!fileWatcher_)
8876 return;
8877 // 移除旧文件监视
8878 if (!watchedFilePath_.isEmpty() && fileWatcher_->files().contains(watchedFilePath_)) {
8879 fileWatcher_->removePath(watchedFilePath_);
8880 }
8881 // 添加新文件监视
8882 if (!filePath.isEmpty() && QFile::exists(filePath)) {
8883 fileWatcher_->addPath(filePath);
8884 watchedFilePath_ = filePath;
8885 } else {
8886 watchedFilePath_.clear();
8887 }
8888}
8889
8890/// 文件被外部修改响应：提示用户重新加载。
8891void Ide::onFileChangedExternally(const QString& filePath) {
8892 // ROUND-60 fix: 关闭流程中忽略文件变更通知，避免 QTimer/singleShot 捕获 this
8893 // 在析构期间触发 UAF。
8894 if (closing_)
8895 return;
8896 if (filePath != watchedFilePath_)
8897 return;
8898
8899 // 弹出对话框询问用户是否重新加载（异步避免阻塞 fileWatcher 信号）
8900 auto askReload = [this](const QString& path) {
8901 auto* msgBox = new QMessageBox(this);
8902 msgBox->setIcon(QMessageBox::Question);
8903 msgBox->setWindowTitle(mlTr("文件已修改"));
8904 msgBox->setText(mlTr("文件已被外部程序修改：\n%1\n\n是否重新加载？").arg(path));
8905 msgBox->setStandardButtons(QMessageBox::Yes | QMessageBox::No);
8906 msgBox->setDefaultButton(QMessageBox::Yes);
8907 msgBox->setAttribute(Qt::WA_DeleteOnClose);
8908 connect(msgBox, &QMessageBox::finished, this, [this, path](int result) {
8909 if (result != QMessageBox::Yes)
8910 return;
8911 // 重新加载文件：已打开则从磁盘重读对应标签，否则新开标签
8912 int idx = findTabForFile(path);
8913 if (idx >= 0) {
8914 loadFileIntoTab(idx, path);
8915 } else {
8916 loadFile(path);
8917 }
8918 });
8919 msgBox->show();
8920 };
8921
8922 // IDE 自身保存触发的 fileChanged，跳过弹框
8923 if (selfSaving_) {
8924 selfSaving_ = false;
8925 // 文件可能被替换后旧 watch 失效，重新添加
8926 if (!fileWatcher_->files().contains(filePath) && QFile::exists(filePath)) {
8927 fileWatcher_->addPath(filePath);
8928 }
8929 return;
8930 }
8931
8932 // 文件可能已被删除（某些编辑器先删再写）
8933 if (!QFile::exists(filePath)) {
8934 QTimer::singleShot(100, this, [this, filePath, askReload]() {
8935 if (filePath != watchedFilePath_)
8936 return;
8937 if (QFile::exists(filePath)) {
8938 if (!fileWatcher_->files().contains(filePath)) {
8939 fileWatcher_->addPath(filePath);
8940 }
8941 // 文件被重建，询问是否重新加载
8942 askReload(filePath);
8943 }
8944 });
8945 return;
8946 }
8947
8948 // 重新添加监视（文件被替换后旧 watch 失效）
8949 if (!fileWatcher_->files().contains(filePath)) {
8950 fileWatcher_->addPath(filePath);
8951 }
8952
8953 askReload(filePath);
8954}
